title: 第12章 超神境第13章 重建圣天家园
content_zh:
“哦，对了，我想问一下超神境的事。”邪帝这时开口了，“超神境，你们一族存在那么久，没有超神境强者嘛？族地里还有其他老祖么？感觉你们神境也不是很多啊。你们这样的隐藏势力好像有点菜诶，那蛊族都有五个神境巅峰。”
“这个嘛......”圣天丽华不知如何开口。
“超神境嘛？现在的天地环境无法使人突破到超神境，要是天地环境进化，你们五个应该能直接进入超神境了吧。不过现在的超神境都隐世不出，都是不知道多少年以前的人物咯，不知道还有几个活着的，我知道现存宇宙可以寻觅到的一位超神境强者以及一个势力，一个只有超神境的势力。”圣天极剑缓缓开口。圣天极剑毕竟以前行走世间，知晓一些辛秘。
“超神殿嘛，已经被我灭了。”邪帝好像随口说了件很简单的事情。
“对，就是超神殿，一个只有......什么？！等等，嗯？你说什么？超神殿被你灭了，这这这，怎么可能！！？？
超神殿殿主可是超神境巅峰的修为，你杀一个超神境初期我信一点点，毕竟跨一个小境界，但你才神境巅峰，整整一个大境界啊，这怎么可能！
哪怕你是妖孽，但神境巅峰与超神境巅峰之间有着不可逾越的鸿沟，超神境相当于开启一条新的修行之路啊！说实话，神境巅峰对战超神境初期都难啊！”圣天极剑满脸不信。
“一年前，超神殿追杀我，我开了五天五夜的战狂圣体，才勉强杀掉超神殿殿主，反正超神殿那些家伙都被我杀光了。一个没留。”邪帝回忆了下一年前，说的轻巧，但这之间的苦楚只有邪帝自己知晓。当时邪帝让战神众人不要插手。
“你是战狂圣体！！难怪可以。好啊好啊，哈哈哈哈，超神殿那帮家伙本就该死。父亲啊，有人帮你报了你的仇啊。”圣天正锋快要哭了。
战狂圣体！先天战斗圣体，一旦进入战斗一个半小时后，可以开启。开启后，全属性每秒翻倍递增，使用武技不消耗能量。脱离战斗半小时后自动解除。没有任何副作用。可想而知邪帝是五天五夜没有休息。
“如你所见，我族神境确实不多了。我的公公，就是正锋的父亲，是位超神境强者，超神境后期。当年父亲不想加入超神殿，而被那殿主所杀。
并且将我族超神境与神境强者屠杀殆尽。他跟我们讲一定要为他报仇，我的婆婆也抑郁而终。那个时候的天地环境还足以容纳超神境甚至更强的强者，但过了几百年后，天地环境退化了，一直到今天，我等还未入超神境。”圣天丽华缓缓道出当年之事。
“果然境界是越来越往上的啊。”比超神境还强的强者。
“超神境之上，还有破天境与释天境，但那个年代已经很少见了。天地环境不是很容易容纳，都怕被天道抹杀而不出手。”
“你们知道天地环境为何退化吗？”女帝对于天地环境这方面是有涉猎的，据她了解，天地环境只会进化。这是一种成长，不存在退化，应是直接消失才对。
“不知道，无人知晓此事之秘，或许神知、天知、地知。”
“不管这个了，什么破天释天，乱七八糟的，我觉的前辈你说的也很乱，以后再说吧。极剑前辈你认识那位超神境是谁啊？”邪帝阻止了这个话题的继续。
“......"圣天丽华嘴角一抽，不你问的么？我讲了你说我乱讲是吧？
“就在你们战铠大陆，云海海域，云上城城主，云昊！”
“云上城？知道了，多谢。”邪帝想起了以前在云海不好的事，但很好，没有表露出来。

“那我们就先告辞了，有缘再会。”
“不行！你们一定要多留几天，邪帝你替我父亲报了仇，我这个做儿子的一定要好好感谢你们，祖地里面想要什么你们随便拿，务必让我们多款待你们几天。”圣天正锋已经在一边老泪纵横半天了。
“老大，人家那么想，我们就多留几天吧，回去也只不过是在家里待着，还不如在这多玩几天呢，是吧老大。”冰帝看了一眼五人，一个个都是想留下，“那就留下来玩几天吧，顺便帮圣天一族重建一下族地吧。
“芜湖，老大万岁！”
战神队六人还真在祖地里面好好逛了逛，什么也没拿，因为这里有的邪帝都可以搞来，这里没有的，邪帝也有可能搞来。
谁能想到一场危机，战神队来的第二天就解决了。晚上自然是好好款待了一下，比前一晚还要丰盛，不少小孩从远处偷看，好奇大英雄长什么样，只看见邪帝在狂吃。
“我一定要偷偷干饭，然后饿死所有人。”众人满头黑线。

"Oh, by the way, I want to ask about the Super God Realm." The Evil Emperor spoke at this time, "Super God Realm, your clan has been around for so long, and there are no strong people in the Super God Realm? Are there other ancestors in the clan? It seems that you don't have many God Realms. Hidden forces like you seem to be a bit weak, and the Gu clan has five peaks of the God Realm."
"Well..." Sheng Tianlihua didn't know how to speak.
"What about the Super God Realm? The current environment of heaven and earth cannot allow people to break through to the Super God Realm. If the environment of heaven and earth evolves, the five of you should be able to directly enter the Super God Realm. However, the current Super God Realm cannot be hidden from the world. They are all characters from I don't know how many years ago. I don't know how many are still alive. I know that there is a strong Super God Realm and a force that can be found in the existing universe. A force that only has the Super God Realm." Shengtian Jijian slowly spoke. After all, the Holy Tianji Sword has walked in the world before and knows some secrets.
"The Super Temple has been destroyed by me." The Evil Emperor seemed to have said a very simple thing casually.
"Yes, it's the Super Temple. There's only...what?! Wait, eh? What did you say? The Super Temple was destroyed by you. How is this possible?!?
The Master of the Super God Realm is at the pinnacle of the Super God Realm. I believe you a little bit if you kill someone who is in the early stage of the Super God Realm. After all, it is a small realm, but you are at the peak of the God Realm, a whole big realm. How is this possible!
Even if you are a monster, there is an insurmountable gap between the peak of the divine realm and the peak of the super-god realm. The super-god realm is equivalent to opening a new path of practice! To be honest, it is difficult to fight at the peak of the divine realm against the early stage of the super-god realm! "Sheng Tianji Sword's face was full of disbelief.
"One year ago, the Super Temple was chasing me. I opened the War Mad Holy Body for five days and five nights, and then I barely managed to kill the master of the Super Temple. Anyway, I killed all the guys in the Super Temple. Not a single one was left." The Evil Emperor recalled the next year, speaking lightly, but only the Evil Emperor himself knew the pain during this period. At that time, the Evil Emperor asked the God of War and others not to interfere.
"You are the Holy Body of War Madness!! No wonder you can. Okay, okay, hahahaha, those guys from the Super Temple deserve to die. Father, someone has avenged your revenge for you." Shengtian Zhengfeng was about to cry.
War mad holy body! The Innate Combat Holy Body can be activated once one and a half hours into the battle. After turning it on, all attributes will double and increase every second, and using martial arts will not consume energy. Automatically disables after being out of combat for half an hour. There are no side effects. It is conceivable that the Evil Emperor did not rest for five days and five nights.
"As you can see, there are really not many gods in our clan left. My father-in-law, Zheng Feng's father, is a strong man in the super god realm, late in the super god realm. At that time, my father did not want to join the super god temple, but was killed by the temple master.
And slaughtered all the super-god realm and god-realm experts in our clan. He told us that we must avenge him, and my mother-in-law also died of depression. At that time, the environment of heaven and earth was still enough to accommodate those who were in the super-god realm or even stronger. However, after a few hundred years, the environment of heaven and earth has degraded. To this day, we have not yet entered the super-god realm. "Shengtian Lihua slowly told what happened back then.
"Sure enough, the realm is getting higher and higher." A strong man who is stronger than the super god realm.
"Beyond the Super God Realm, there are also the Sky-Breaking Realm and the Sky-breaking Realm, but they are rare in that era. The environment of heaven and earth is not easy to accommodate, and they are afraid of being obliterated by the Heavenly Dao without taking action."
"Do you know why the environment of heaven and earth degrades?" The empress is involved in the environment of heaven and earth. According to her understanding, the environment of heaven and earth will only evolve. This is a kind of growth, there is no degradation, it should simply disappear.
"I don't know. No one knows the secret of this matter. Maybe God knows, heaven knows, or earth knows."
"Never mind this, it's all a mess about breaking the sky and releasing the sky. I think what you said, senior, is also very messy. Let's talk about it later. Senior Jijian, do you know who the super-god realm is?" The Evil Emperor stopped the topic from continuing.
“…..." Sheng Tianlihua's mouth twitched, "Didn't you ask? I told you that you said I was talking nonsense, right?"
"In your War Armor Continent, in the sea of ​​clouds, the lord of Yunshang City, Yun Hao! "
"Yunshang City? Got it, thank you. "The Evil Emperor thought of the bad things he did in Yunhai before, but he was very good and didn't show it.
"Then let's say goodbye first and see you again if we are destined. "
"no! You must stay a few more days. Evil Emperor, you have avenged my father. As a son, I must thank you. You can take whatever you want from the ancestral land. You must let us entertain you for a few more days. "Shengtian Zhengfeng has been crying for a long time.
"Boss, if people think so, let's stay a few more days. We are just staying at home when we go back. We might as well play here for a few more days, right boss. "The Ice Emperor glanced at the five people, and all of them wanted to stay, "Then stay and play for a few days, and by the way help the Shengtian clan rebuild their clan.
"Wuhu, long live the boss!"
The six members of the God of War team really took a walk around the ancestral land and didn't take anything, because they could get any evil emperor here, and they could get any evil emperor that wasn't here.
Who would have thought that a crisis would be solved the day after the Ares team arrived. Naturally, there was a good treat in the evening, which was even more sumptuous than the night before. Many children peeked from a distance, wondering what the great hero looked like, only to see the Evil Emperor eating like crazy.
"I must work secretly and then starve everyone to death." Everyone had black lines on their heads.
